notices.title: Construction defect notice (all capitals form)
notices.trigger: Contract for the construction or improvement of a residence in which the contract amount exceeds $5,000
notices.format: Conspicuous notice in substantially the statutory capital-letter form; may be part of the contract; no type size stated
notices.support: in which the contract amount exceeds $5,000
notices.summary_row: Construction defect notice for contracts over $5,000 (all capitals form)
notices.hold_reason: the block is the whole statute section; besides the capital-letter notice it holds subsection I (the contractor's duty) and subsection II (third party warranty programs) and a source line, which should not print in the customer's contract

notices.title: Cancellation statement in 10 point boldface next to the buyer's signature
notices.trigger: Sale of $150 or more solicited and made at any place other than the seller's permanent place of business, cash or credit
notices.format: Statement in boldface type of at least 10 points, in immediate proximity to the buyer's signature space; the federal form is accepted instead
notices.support: in boldface type of a minimum size of 10 points, a statement in substantially the following form
notices.summary_row: Cancellation statement (10 point boldface next to the buyer's signature), refund in 15 days, no deduction for work done
notices.hold_reason: the block is the whole chapter 361-B (definition, remedies, disclosure rules, refund rules); only the one cancellation statement in 361-B:2, I belongs in the contract, and the rest should not print

changes.new: Three business days under RSA 361-B (sales of $150 or more away from the seller's place of business) and the federal rule; refund within 15 days, no deduction for work done
changes.support: New Hampshire has one: RSA chapter 361-B, "Retail Selling", in Title XXXIII-A

changes.new: Home solicitation sales of $150 or more made at any place other than the seller's permanent place of business, cash or credit, on top of the federal rule
changes.support: to a "solicitation and sale at any place other than a permanent place of business of the seller", cash or credit, with no exception for a buyer who invited the seller

changes.new: Chapter 361-B does not define business day. On cancellation the seller refunds everything within 15 days and may not deduct the value of work already done.

unsure: NH-defect: the capital-letter notice belongs in the contract over $5,000, but the file only offers it inside the whole 359-G:7 block (with the contractor's duty and a warranty rule), so it is held.

NH-cancel: added; the statement belongs in the contract, but the only block is the whole chapter 361-B, so it is held. The $150 floor is on the price and the builder's amount may include items the statute counts differently.

cleaning.home_solicitation_applies_to_cleaning: left false, but 361-B:1 reaches any sale of goods or services of $150 or more, so it may now be true for cleaning plans sold at the home; the file does not say so outright.
cancellation.saturday_counts: left true because the file says business day is not defined in chapter 361-B.
